item.title: ONLY ON 13: Man shares survival story following partial parking garage collapse
item.description: Weeks after a parking garage partially collapsed underneath his car, a man is sharing his survival story only with ABC13.

item.title: Dancing with the Stars Con brings ballroom magic to Palm Springs for the first fan convention
item.description: Dust off your dancing shoes! The first-ever Dancing with the Stars Con is coming to Palm Springs this summer. Featuring pros, judges and stars like Robert Irwin and JoJo Siwa, this three-day event is the ultimate fan experience. Tickets go on sale Feb. 14.

item.title: University of Houston shortstop reflects on remarkable journey in his final college baseball season
item.description: The 25-year-old wouldn't trade a moment on the long road that led him to his final college baseball season.

item.title: Fort Bend ISD said closing 7 schools could impact less than 1 percent of budget
item.description: After months of discussion, surveys, and meetings, some Fort Bend ISD parents can't believe it's all over less than one percent of the district's budget.

item.title: Historic Riverside Hospital in Third Ward, Houston's first for Black people, comes back to life
item.description: Riverside Hospital in Third Ward was Houston's first hospital for Black people. During Black History Month, it is being restored to reopen after more than a decade of closure.

item.title: Couple denies squatter accusations as they fight to stay in Fifth Ward home they don't legally own
item.description: A Houston couple living in a Fifth Ward home they do not legally own is fighting to remain there, even as the city says the structure is unsafe and should be demolished.

item.title: 5-year-old girl killed after being ejected during car crash in southeast Houston, HPD says
item.description: A 5-year-old girl is dead after being ejected from a vehicle in a major crash near Hermann Park in southeast Houston, according to HPD.

item.title: Kate Hudson, Timothée Chalamet, Elle Fanning among Oscars Nominees Luncheon attendees
item.description: It's the most exclusive lunch in Hollywood! We're taking you inside the 2026 Oscars Nominees Luncheon with nominees like Kate Hudson, Timothée Chalamet, Elle Fanning and more. Watch "The Oscars" LIVE Sunday March 15 on ABC and Hulu.

item.title: 16-year-old shot during online sale meetup in Spring, Precinct 4 Constable says
item.description: An investigation is underway after a 16-year-old was shot in Spring on Tuesday evening, according to the Harris County Precinct 4 Constable's Office.

item.title: Attorney says he was tricked into giving drug-laced paper to inmate
item.description: The Harris County Criminal Lawyers Association is warning its members after another lawyer was tricked into smuggling drug-laced paper into the Harris County Jail.
